title: Coffee subscription cancellation
ask: Daniel Okafor wants to stop his Peel Street Coffee subscription. His email is in inbox/customer.txt. Confirm it for him, make one offer to stay, and send the reply.
background: His last box is already roasted and goes out on 14 March.
He has been with us for two years on the 500g filter plan.
If he says no to the offer, that is fine, we just stop.

constraints.text: keep it to 90 words or fewer
offer him a percentage off if he stays, but no more than 20%
begin with "Hi Daniel," on its own line
don't write "sad to see you go"
send him one email only, no follow-up
give the date of his last box, 14 March

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: daniel.okafor@customer.example
Subject: Cancel subscription

Please cancel my subscription, I am moving overseas.

Daniel
